question.text: Which of the following is TRUE about options vs futures payoffs?

answer.text: Options have asymmetric payoffs; Futures have symmetric (linear) payoffs
Options have symmetric payoffs; Futures have asymmetric payoffs

explanation.text: The Logic: Options are asymmetric: buyer's loss is capped at premium, but profit potential is unlimited. Futures are symmetric: both long and short have unlimited profit AND unlimited loss potential. The Trap: This asymmetry is the fundamental reason options are used for insurance-style hedging.
